title: Training Completion Gate
description: Checks required training courses for completion and explicit expiry dates against a caller-supplied date. It returns a gate result without enrolling or changing records.
decision: The result is complete when every required course is completed and either has no expiry or expires on or after today. Optional incomplete courses do not block the gate, while missing or expired required courses do.
inputs: The caller supplies unique course names, required and completed booleans, optional YYYY-MM-DD expiry dates, and a YYYY-MM-DD today value. All date comparisons are calendar-date comparisons with no machine clock access.
limitations: This core cannot verify course identity, attendance, assessment scores, equivalence, or whether an expiry policy is appropriate. It does not notify learners, update a learning system, grant access, or provide employment or legal advice.
